summary.text: Rob Hodgkinson is the Libertarian candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Rick James (R).
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Libertarian Party of Kansas.

paragraphs.text: Hodgkinson attended Kansas State University, and his professional experience includes working as a realtor, according to Ballotpedia.
He was the Libertarian nominee for Kansas Secretary of State in 2018, receiving 3.5 percent of the vote in a race won by Scott Schwab (R).

In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, he said his priorities included increasing voter registration and participation and making the Secretary of State's website more user-friendly, and that he had worked on election issues for 15 years from a third-party point of view.
